segments.text: Knowing when to switch from the good to the great is the greatest opportunity, or is the greatest skill that you can develop as a man in your 20s, 30s, for the rest of your career
When we were selling booty bands, and what I felt like, we plateaued that business. It's because we were the number one selling booty band business in America.
It was time to move on. I had logical data in front of me that this could not scale as fast as I would like it to, and there was a greater opportunity, such as greens, powders, or beverage.

So if I just look at the Greens category, total addressable market, I see can't really get larger than a quarter billion dollars a year. I look at the energy drink market and I look at multi-ten, multi-deca billion dollar opportunity to go after.
That's why I move on to larger challenges.
and I continue to practice that muscle as I age.
